links.outcome: Local ambient scribe documentation time, note length, and usage after rollout
links.effect: Median note-editing time was lower with AI assistance (~4.0 vs 11.8 min), with similar median note length (~4000 characters). Documentation accuracy, quality, and burnout were not assessed.
links.quote: Median note-editing time was lower with AI assistance (∼4.0 vs 11.8 min), while median note length was similar (∼4000 characters).

unlisted_practices: Analysis of ambient scribe utilization by clinician role and visit type to identify adoption patterns

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world deployment, clinician adoption, and documentation efficiency of an ambient AI scribe in pediatric otolaryngology practice without testing a specific safeguard or deployment practice variation.
